title: Whole Long Apron Box and Rear Vertical Drum Spreader
description: One independently authored complete empty rear-drum agricultural spreader-trailer appearance. A long low towable frame with two full road wheels and a finite parking prop carries a deep outward-sided box with a closed front, whole slatted apron floor and genuinely open rear. Beyond that opening a full-height independent bearing gate supports two complete vertical drums, each with a continuous thick blunt helical vane; lower and upper beams join the whole frame. The long apron-box-to-rear-upright-drum relationship differs from the existing hand-push round funnel and horizontal spinner underneath, and from the compact closed-back cargo tub. All visible coordinates are new, not old trailer geometry with extra cargo or a copied auger. One model zero scenes, four opaque PBR materials, no contents. Static fixed artistic exterior only: no conveying, manure/fertilizer compatibility, throwing, drive, flow, coverage, rotation, coupling fit, towing, load, handling, manufacture or safety performance. Rigging animation interaction not made.
